steps.script: for source in *.c; do cc -O0 "$source" -o "${source%.c}" || exit 1; done; c++ -O0 cpp-check.cpp -o cpp-check
printf 'int first(void) { return 1; }\n' > first.c; printf 'int second(void) { return 2; }\n' > second.c; cc -c first.c && cc -c second.c && ar rcs library.a first.o second.o
printf 'int first(void) { return 3; }\n' > first.c; cc -c first.c && ar rcs library.a ./first.o
printf 'int third(void) { return 4; }\n' > third.c; cc -c third.c && ar rcs library.a third.o
printf 'int first(void), second(void), third(void); int main(void) { return first()!=3 || second()!=2 || third()!=4; }\n' > archive.c; cc archive.c library.a -o archive && ./archive
cmp library.a saved.a && ar rcs library.a && cmp library.a saved.a
printf invalid > invalid.a; cp invalid.a saved.a
mkdir duplicate; cp second.o duplicate/first.o; ar rcs duplicate.a first.o duplicate/first.o third.o; cc archive.c duplicate.a -o archive && ./archive

steps.why: The Rust cc crate's sequence: quick appends, then the index.
steps.script: rm library.a; ar cqD library.a first.o second.o && ar cq library.a third.o && ar sD library.a && cc archive.c library.a -o archive && ./archive

steps.why: an index for a missing archive

steps.script: printf 'static volatile unsigned char data[20 * 1024 * 1024] = {1};\nint main(void) { data[sizeof(data)-1]=42; return data[0]!=1 || data[sizeof(data)-1]!=42; }\n' > memory.c

steps.why: An explicit initial memory covers the data, the stack and cc's 8 MiB heap.
the compiler rejects memory above the process ceiling

steps.script: cp self-exe-check identity-one && cp self-exe-check identity-two && ln -s self-exe-check identity-alias
/bin/slop -c 'export DOLLY_PROCESS_CHECK=private-memory; case "$DOLLY_PROCESS_CHECK" in private-memory) : ;; *) exit 94 ;; esac; ./process-check fresh'

steps.why: Standard input is the session's terminal.
The driver follows Clang's output names and input kinds.
steps.script: mkdir src && printf 'int main(void) { return 0; }\n' > src/unit.c && cc -c src/unit.c && test -f unit.o && test ! -e src/unit.o
cc -c -MD src/unit.c -o built.o && grep -q '^built.o: src/unit.c' built.d && cc -c -MMD src/unit.c && grep -q '^unit.o: src/unit.c' unit.d
cp unit.o unit.lo && cc unit.lo -o linked && ./linked
printf 'int unit(void) { return 1; }\n' > library.c && cc -shared -Wl,-h,libunit.so.1 library.c -o soname.so
printf 'int missing(void);\nint use(void) { return missing(); }\n' > undefined.c && cc -shared undefined.c -o undefined.so

steps.why: No WebAssembly assembler: guarded foreign assembly is an empty object, real assembly fails.

printf '#if defined(__x86_64__)
  movq %%rax, %%rbx
#endif
' > guarded.S && cc -c guarded.S -o guarded.o && test -s guarded.o
